# dtcloud_storage_policies (Data Source)

Lists the storage policies available in the region.

`storage_policy` is required on every volume and there is no default, so without this the valid values have to be learned out of band. The endpoint returns only the policies whose quota is non-zero -- it cross-references the project's storage quota against the volume types -- so what comes back is what this project can actually create on, not the whole platform catalogue.

Both `id` and `name` are exposed, but `name` is the one to pass to `dtcloud_volume.storage_policy`: the volume details endpoint reports the policy by name, so a volume created with an id would read back as a name and drift on every plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_storage_policies" "available" {}

output "policy_names" {
  value = data.dtcloud_storage_policies.available.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return the policy with this exact name. Applied by the provider — the API has no filter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `names` (List of String) Just the policy names, for when all you need is to check one is available.
- `policies` (List of Object) Storage policies this project has quota for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))
